description: List limit orders (Solana: Jupiter Trigger; EVM: CoW Protocol) of a wallet, or of the API key's account without a wallet: what is sold, the minimum received, status (built, open, filled, cancelled, expired, failed) and fills. Read-only.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous call, for the next page.

wallet.description: Wallet (Solana base58 or EVM 0x) whose limit orders to list. Without it: the API key's account (needs a key).

name: list_limit_orders
title: List limit orders
